_about: How F (inspect) moves a weapon. CS 1.6 has no inspect animation, so this is procedural. mode 'bones': the listed bones (names in the CS model) and everything attached turn about their own origin; with several bones each one is mirrored to its side (GoldSrc +Y = left), so two hands turn symmetrically. Angles are degrees about the model's X (forward), Y (left) and Z (up); lift in model units. Weapons not listed tilt as a whole toward the viewer.
